por_que: Miniaturas finales de 1311, rehechas sobre las elegidas de la 2.ª tanda (2.02, 2.03, 2.04, 2.05, 2.06, 2.07) con todo lo aprendido: cara ~30 % a la lente y boca cerrada en plano cercano, el atrezo que dice el título dentro de una escena que pasa, el suelo nunca corta el cuerpo (agachado, de rodillas o detrás de algo con sentido), la escala dicha con una medida del cuerpo, nada de imagen partida ni texto.
prefijo: Create a YouTube thumbnail, 16:9 landscape, everything important in the central area. Attached image 1 is the man: keep his exact face, wavy brown hair, full beard, build, grey sleeveless hoodie and red work gloves (same person, do not beautify, do not change his age).
sufijo: FRAMING: close shot, his face about 30 % of the frame height, well lit, looking straight into the lens, calm wide-eyed deadpan, mouth closed. His body is never cut by the ground: if he is low, he kneels or crouches with his knees visible, or something meaningful in front covers him. STYLE: like a top YouTube thumbnail: one huge hero prop that tells the story, simple composition, bright saturated daylight colors, clean uncluttered background, everything razor sharp. Photorealistic, like a real photo, not an illustration, no plastic AI skin. No text, no logos, no watermarks, nothing in the bottom-right corner.

conceptos.titulo: Me Di 1 Hora para Decorar un Estanque Entero
conceptos.idea: Despertador gigante sonando en el borde del estanque a medio plantar; él de rodillas plantando, cerca
conceptos.escena: SCENE: a garden pond half planted: one half lush with water lilies, the other half still bare gravel and water. In the left foreground, on the brick edge of the pond, a giant red vintage twin-bell alarm clock as tall as his torso is ringing and shaking, its hands at almost one hour. He kneels on the brick edge right next to it, close to the camera, leaning over the water and pushing a plant into the mud with both gloved hands, and looks into the lens.

conceptos.titulo: Intenté Salvar Plantas de una Tierra de Cemento
conceptos.idea: Pala con la hoja doblada en ángulo recto clavada en tierra como cemento; él de rodillas con el martillo neumático
conceptos.escena: SCENE: rock-hard cracked grey earth like concrete, white picket fence behind. In the left foreground, big and sharp, a garden spade stuck in the ground whose metal blade is clearly folded back at 90 degrees, crumpled as if it had hit concrete. In the middle, a reed plant with its roots trapped in the hard earth. He kneels right behind them, close to the camera, holding a yellow jackhammer against the ground, stone chips flying, safety goggles pushed up on his forehead, and looks into the lens.

conceptos.titulo: Intenté Salvar Plantas de una Tierra de Cemento
conceptos.idea: El perro sentado junto al hoyo perfecto que él no ha podido cavar; él agachado con la pala partida
conceptos.escena: Image 2 is his dog: keep the exact same big white dog. SCENE: rock-hard cracked grey earth. In the foreground, a deep, perfectly round hole just dug, earth on its rim. On the right of the hole the big white dog sits proudly, earth on its front paws and nose. On the left he crouches close to the camera, knees visible, holding a spade snapped in two, one half in each hand, a small plant with roots at his feet, and looks into the lens.

conceptos.titulo: Mi Perro Gigante No Me Deja Plantar el Estanque
conceptos.idea: Él empuja la carretilla llena de plantas y el perro va tumbado encima como un rey
conceptos.escena: Image 2 is his dog: keep the exact same big white dog. SCENE: close shot, he pushes a green wheelbarrow overflowing with pond plants straight toward the camera; the wheelbarrow fills the lower part of the frame and covers his legs. The big white dog lies relaxed on top of the plants like a king, eyes half closed, its head near the camera. His face is right above the dog, close, exhausted, looking into the lens. Garden pond and white fence softly behind.

conceptos.titulo: Mi Perro Gigante No Me Deja Plantar el Estanque
conceptos.idea: El perro corre a cámara con una maceta en la boca; él justo detrás intentando cogerlo
conceptos.escena: Image 2 is his dog: keep the exact same big white dog. SCENE: the big white dog runs straight at the camera, big and sharp in the foreground, carrying a whole terracotta pot with a pond plant in its mouth, soil and water flying. Right behind it, close, he lunges forward with one gloved hand reaching for the dog, his whole body visible down to his boots on the grass, his face large and sharp, eyes wide, mouth closed, looking into the lens. Garden pond behind.

conceptos.titulo: Un Pájaro Salvaje Estrenó Mi Estanque Nuevo
conceptos.idea: Inauguración: cinta roja cortada sobre el estanque y el pajarito posado en la punta, grande; él con las tijeras doradas
conceptos.escena: Image 2 is the bird: keep the exact same tiny species and plumage (yellow crown stripe with black edges, white wing bars). SCENE: an opening ceremony at a freshly planted garden pond: a red satin ribbon with a bow, just cut in the middle. The bird perches on the cut end of the ribbon in the right foreground, very close to the lens so it looks big (as large as his head in the frame) and razor sharp. He crouches at the edge of the pond on the left, knees on the brick edge, holding giant golden ceremonial scissors open, and looks into the lens.
